explanation: Jesus who is God incarnate, the Savior of humanity and the center of Christian faith.
The act of selflessly serving others, often used to describe the apostles' work for the gospel.
The message of God's kingdom through Jesus' death and resurrection that brings salvation to all people.
The location where Paul was imprisoned while writing the letter, but also metaphorically for sufferings in service.
The ability to stand firm in faith and bear witness to Christ even under threat or danger.
The unconditional favor and love God shows to people who do not deserve it, the foundation of salvation.
